def compute_liveness(states, edges, fair, start, n, done, reach):
    DECL = (1 << len(fair)) - 1
    lbl_bit = {}
    q = 0
    for a, m in fair:
        lbl_bit[a] = 1 << q
        q += 1
    if fair and len(fair) > 0:
        pass
    liveb = [reach[s] and not done[s] for s in range(n)]
    live = [s for s in range(n) if liveb[s]]
    if not live:
        return True, None
    enm_state = [0] * n
    for s, lab, t in edges:
        b = lbl_bit.get(lab)
        if b:
            enm_state[s] |= b
    idmap = {}
    for i, s in enumerate(live):
        idmap[s] = i
    k = len(live)
    adj = [[] for _ in range(k)]
    m_nodes = []
    for eid in range(len(edges)):
        s, lab, t = edges[eid]
        if s in idmap and t in idmap:
            b = lbl_bit.get(lab)
            if b is None:
                adj[idmap[s]].append(idmap[t])
            else:
                mid = len(adj)
                adj.append([])
                m_nodes.append((eid, b))
                adj[idmap[s]].append(mid)
                adj[mid].append(idmap[t])
    for i in range(k):
        adj[i].append(i)
    tot = len(adj)
    enmask = [0] * tot
    mmask = [0] * tot
    ymask = [0] * tot
    for i in range(k):
        enm = enm_state[live[i]]
        enmask[i] = enm
        ymask[i] = (~enm) & DECL
    for jj, (eid, b) in enumerate(m_nodes):
        nd = k + jj
        ymask[nd] = b
        mmask[nd] = b
    allnodes = list(range(tot))
    comps = tarjan_subset(allnodes, set(allnodes), adj)
    members = [c for c in comps]
    work = list(range(len(members)))
    active = [True] * len(members)
    clean = []
    while work:
        c = work.pop()
        if not active[c]:
            continue
        mem = members[c]
        orE = 0
        orM = 0
        orY = 0
        for v in mem:
            orE |= enmask[v]
            orM |= mmask[v]
            orY |= ymask[v]
        rm = None
        for i in range(len(fair)):
            if fair[i][1] == "weak":
                if not ((orY >> i) & 1):
                    rm = mem
                    break
        if rm is None:
            for i in range(len(fair)):
                if fair[i][1] == "strong":
                    if ((orE >> i) & 1) and not ((orM >> i) & 1):
                        bb = 1 << i
                        rm = [v for v in mem if enmask[v] & bb]
                        break
        if rm is None:
            clean.append(mem)
            active[c] = False
            continue
        active[c] = False
        if len(rm) == len(mem):
            continue
        rmset = set(rm)
        rem = [v for v in mem if v not in rmset]
        for nc in tarjan_subset(rem, set(rem), adj):
            members.append(nc)
            active.append(True)
            work.append(len(members) - 1)
    if not clean:
        return True, None
    adjl = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for eid in range(len(edges)):
        s, lab, t = edges[eid]
        if liveb[s] and liveb[t]:
            adjl[s].append((eid, t))
    cand = []
    for mem in clean:
        cp = set()
        for v in mem:
            if v < k:
                cp.add(live[v])
        if cp:
            cand.append((len(cp), cp))
    cand.sort()
    for _, cp in cand:
        path, tgt = bfs_path(start, adjl, n, lambda u: u in cp)
        if path is None:
            continue
        loop = build_fair_loop(cp, edges, fair, enm_state, tgt)
        if loop is None:
            continue
        if len(loop) + len(path) > 900000:
            continue
        return False, (path, loop)
    return True, None
PYEOF
